STYLE_V3: STYLE — painterly 3D animation look in the manner of Fortiche's prestige animated series (Arcane): characters and sets are solid 3D forms but every surface is HAND-PAINTED with visible, directional brush strokes, dry-brush texture and paint smears, like oil paint projected onto sculpted geometry. NOT photorealistic, NOT smooth digital airbrush, NOT anime cel-shading. Faces are stylised: slightly elongated proportions, angular jaw and cheekbones, large expressive eyes with painted highlights, hair in chunky painted clumps not individual strands, skin built from visible colour planes with rough edges. Lighting is bold and graphic: hard rim lights in a second colour, strong two-tone colour contrast (indigo/gold, teal/magenta), volumetric haze and light shafts, deep crushed shadows with jewel-tone accents. Grime, scratches and worn paint everywhere. No outlines, but crisp painted edges; canvas grain over the whole image. Cinematic wide-lens framing, dramatic low or high angles, layered depth with fog. Space-opera setting. Series palette: indigo-violet #2b2a5e, blue-white #cfe3ff, gold #d9b56a; the Baker Corporation is gold thin lines on black glass. No text.
HOLMES: SHERLOCK HOLMES of the Baker Corporation: mid-30s, lean, sharp-featured, dark unruly hair in painted clumps, long charcoal coat with a high collar, gloved hands, a gold Baker Corporation pin, eyes already three steps ahead.
WATSON: WATSON, Baker Corporation service unit W-24-7: a compact chest-high maintenance robot with a boxy lamp-like head, ONE large round amber sensor eye, dented teal chassis with chipped paint and rust, stencilled serial half rubbed off, articulated arms, short sturdy legs, no cape, no face other than the eye.
